metadata.notice: Original MP4 uploaded with audio intact when present; human review required.

concept.done: small round part held off teal surface in closed right gripper visible in cited frames; complete lift unverified beyond held position
concept.pre: small round part resting on teal surface to right of rectangular plate, right gripper open and to the right
concept.target: teal work surface to right of rectangular plate

steps.evidence: In frames frame-000002, frame-000003, frame-000004 the right gripper moves left from the right edge toward the upper small round part on the teal surface, closes around it and lifts it; at frame-000004 the part is no longer on the table and is held in the closed right gripper while the left gripper remains open and idle.

concept.done: small round part resting on one stud of rectangular plate with right gripper open and clear, visible in cited frames; tightening/securing unverified
concept.pre: small round part held in closed right gripper above teal surface
concept.target: upper stud on rectangular plate (stud nearest top of frame, orientation uncertain)

steps.evidence: In frames frame-000005, frame-000006, frame-000007, frame-000008 the right gripper carrying the small round part moves left over the rectangular plate, lowers onto the upper stud and then opens; at frame-000008 the part is seen on the upper stud and the right gripper is open and beginning to retract, with one small round part remaining on the table.

concept.done: second small round part held off teal surface in closed right gripper visible in cited frames; complete lift unverified beyond held position
concept.pre: one small round part remaining on teal surface to right of rectangular plate, one small round part already on rectangular plate stud, right gripper open
concept.target: teal work surface to right of rectangular plate

steps.evidence: In frames frame-000009, frame-000010, frame-000011 the right gripper moves right away from the plate toward the remaining small round part on the teal surface, closes around it and lifts it; at frame-000011 the table position is empty and the part is held in the closed right gripper.

concept.done: small round part resting on remaining stud of rectangular plate with right gripper open and clear, visible in cited frames; tightening/securing unverified
concept.pre: second small round part held in closed right gripper above teal surface
concept.target: lower stud on rectangular plate (stud nearest bottom of frame, orientation uncertain)

steps.evidence: In frames frame-000012, frame-000013, frame-000014 the right gripper carrying the second small round part moves left over the rectangular plate, lowers onto the remaining lower stud and then opens; at frame-000014 both studs of the rectangular plate have a small round part resting on them and the right gripper is open and retracted to the right.
